policy_name: Sample Home Loan Credit Policy v1.0 (FICTIONAL - for demo only)

rules.name: Applicant age
rules.text: Age must be between 21 and 60 at application, and age plus loan tenure must not exceed 70.

rules.name: Minimum income
rules.text: Verified gross monthly income must be at least Rs 25,000.

rules.name: Credit score
rules.text: Credit bureau score of 750 or above is preferred. Below 700 needs senior review.

rules.name: FOIR (fixed obligations to income)
rules.text: Total EMIs including the new loan should not exceed 50% of verified monthly income. 40% or below is preferred.

rules.name: Loan-to-value (LTV)
rules.text: Maximum LTV is 90% up to Rs 30 lakh, 80% up to Rs 75 lakh and 75% above Rs 75 lakh (illustrative, aligned to RBI LTV norms).

rules.name: Property charge check
rules.text: The property must have no existing charge registered in the central collateral registry (CERSAI).

rules.name: Income consistency
rules.text: Income on the income proof should be within 15% of income declared on the application.
